evals.name: boston-offsite-multi-vehicle-alternatives
evals.prompt: Here's the Boston offsite quote we just ran (raw_quote.json attached — it has both Mini Bus and Sprinter units for the 9/18 departure). Go with Mini Bus for both days, add the 5% fuel surcharge and $150 special handling for the Wednesday offsite, and make me an HTML email I can send to Yerdle.
evals.expected_output: One HTML file. Two legs (9/16 offsite as a single 6-hour block with wait at Rowes Wharf; 9/18 departure to BOS). Sprinter unit dropped. Airport stop labeled BOS – Boston Logan International with 'Flight details to be confirmed'. Subtotal $9,355.20, fuel surcharge $467.76, special handling $150.00, total $9,972.96. Terms verbatim. User told the 2:30pm flight was a placeholder.

assertions.name: sprinter-alternative-excluded
assertions.check: output does not contain 'Sprinter'

assertions.name: no-stop-n-placeholder
assertions.check: output does not match /Stop \d/

assertions.name: airport-labeled
assertions.check: output contains 'Boston Logan'

assertions.name: tbd-flight-disclosed
assertions.check: output contains 'to be confirmed'

assertions.name: subtotal-correct
assertions.check: output contains '$9,355.20'

assertions.name: total-correct
assertions.check: output contains '$9,972.96'

assertions.name: no-engine-vocab
assertions.check: output does not contain 'hourly fallback' and does not contain 'rate_id' and does not contain 'inventory'

assertions.name: terms-verbatim
assertions.check: output contains 'This is a quoting tool and therefore builds quotes.'

assertions.name: cancellation-per-leg
assertions.check: output contains '48 hours' at least twice

assertions.name: fuel-bullet-conditional
assertions.check: terms include the 5% fuel bullet only because a fuel line was added

assertions.name: email-in-chat-no-connector
assertions.check: the email appears as a copy-ready block in the reply with the PDF presented alongside; no mail-connector tool is called

assertions.name: single-question-with-defaults
assertions.check: exactly one question is asked between the rate sheet and the deliverable, listing defaults (discount, fuel, cover, event name, intro, contact, map) so 'go' completes it

assertions.name: questions-use-picker
assertions.check: every enumerable question is asked with ask_user_input_v0, one per turn, never as bare prose

assertions.name: verify-before-deliver
assertions.check: verify_document.py runs after rendering and before the reply; a FAIL is fixed and re-verified, never delivered

assertions.name: feedback-fix-then-log
assertions.check: the first deliverable ends with 'Anything you'd like changed?'; a named change is fixed and re-delivered before capture, and the capture carries --change and --fixed

evals.name: wedding-pdf-and-email-draft-csm-benchmark
evals.prompt: Access TCA wedding, Sunday 5/30/2027 at Stonehurst at Hampton Valley, Hartford CT. 120 guests. Two Sprinters for the wedding party (one carrying dresses/garment bags, 6 pax each, ~25 mi) and three Mini Buses covering 3:00pm and 3:15pm outbound waves plus the 11:00pm return — continuous charter, 9 billable hours each. 25% group discount, 5% fuel surcharge. Travel coordinator is Desiree Strobel. Give me the PDF and draft the email to her.
evals.expected_output: Three-page PDF: cover, quote page with A1/A2/A3 refs and line notes (garment bags on A1; wave coverage and continuous-charter rationale on A3), hero total $10,900.58, breakdown subtotal $13,842.00 → discount −$3,460.50 → fuel +$519.08; rate card page with standard/net pairs and a 168-hr cancellation on the Mini Bus. Email draft with subject, three-line summary, total, validity date; created via mail connector only after the user confirms; never sent.
files: fixtures/wedding_quote.json (already-normalized quote.json; skip normalize, apply the two adjustments, render)
